text:
Ava: Customer wants a cautious phased rollout for EU+APAC that enforces per-customer token ceilings and a clear kill-switch ladder. Need a compact ops-ready spec.
Liam: +1. Suggest cohort gating by tenant-size + adaptive thresholds. Start with micro-cohorts (0.5-1% by region) and expand only if telemetry AND spend are within bounds.
Noah: SRE constraints: require blackout-aware scheduling (no APAC weekday evenings), 3x consecutive 5m windows to trigger auto-fallback, and a minimum quiesce period of 10m after any auto-fallback.
Maya: For quality: run a live-harness of 250 synthetic prompts/hr + sample 250 user queries/hr. Monitor embedding cosine drift, hallucination proxy (unexpected tool calls), and response-length variance. Quality gate example: embed_drift > 0.028 OR hallucination_rate > 0.4% -> trip.
Liam: Draft rollout YAML (pseudo):
```
rollout_id: cohort-gate-eu-apac-2026-03
phases:
  - name: micro-cohort
    regions: [eu]
    tenant_sizes: [small]
    pct: 0.7
    duration: 3h
  - name: micro-cohort-2
    regions: [eu]
    tenant_sizes: [medium]
    pct: 2
    duration: 6h
  - name: regional-sample
    regions: [apac]
    tenant_sizes: [small]
    pct: 0.5
    duration: weekend-only
  - name: econ-ab
    sample_pct: 4
    duration: 48h
telemetry_gates:
  latency_p95_increase_pct: 28
  error_rate_abs: 0.4
  embedding_drift: 0.028
economics_gates:
  token_cost_increase_pct: 10
  daily_spend_threshold_usd: 900
token_budget_policy:
  per_tenant_hourly_limit: true
  shed_strategy: [downgrade_quantized, cache, deny]
fallback_sequence:
  - action: route_to
    target: model-stable-v1
  - action: set_flag
    flag: rollout.cohort_gate_eu_apac_2026_03=0
  - action: freeze_all
flags:
  key: rollout.cohort_gate_eu_apac_2026_03
  per_tenant_opt_in: true
  manual_override: true
```
Noah: Add hysteresis: once fallback executes, lock re-enable for min 10m; require 3 clean windows to lift. All fallback events must include correlation-id and be posted to #oncall-rollouts.
Liam: Implementation detail: feature flag service must support region+tenant-size targeting and immutable flag names for audit. Routing change should take effect within 30s.
Maya: A/B analysis rules: compare cohort vs control on embedding score and cost-per-token. For economics gate require p < 0.05 and an upper-bound cost delta < 8% to proceed. Provide per-tenant exception list in the post-mortem.
Ava: Customer asks: enterprise accounts should be explicitly opted-in for week 1 and require CS approval. Add an approval webhook that creates the per-account flag.
Liam: Example ops CLI snippets for rollback/kill-switch:
```
# immediate routing fallback
curl -X POST https://internal.api/routing/fallback -d '{"rollout":"cohort-gate-eu-apac-2026-03","target":"model-stable-v1"}'
# flip feature flag
curl -X POST https://internal.api/flags/rollout.cohort_gate_eu_apac_2026_03 -d '{"value":0}'
```
Noah: Also add a soft-stop per-tenant command to stop sampling that tenant into the cohort without flipping the global flag. Example: `POST /internal/rollouts/ban-tenant {"tenant":"acct-1234"}`. This is useful for customer-driven aborts.
Maya: Telemetry windows: use rolling 5m for latency/error and rolling 1h for cost. Require 3 consecutive 5m violation windows OR 2 consecutive 1h cost windows to trigger economics fallback.
Liam: Token-budget shedding flow: if tenant_hourly_tokens > budget*0.9 -> downgrade that tenant to quantized variant; if exceeds budget*0.98 for >10m -> return cached token-limited responses; if still >budget -> block new requests (last resort). Log each step.
ops-bot: Canary started: rollout=cohort-gate-eu-apac-2026-03 slice=eu-small pct=0.7 start=7071234567
Ava: Launch criteria (draft):
- Micro-cohorts (EU small + medium) run 24h without gate trips
- A/B econ phase shows cost delta < 8% and quality regressions < 0.4%
- Ops runbook validated with dry-run by SRE
- Enterprise opt-ins processed and CS signoff done
Noah: Contract tests: verify function-calling payloads, tool-calls, and streaming fallbacks work end-to-end on fallback model. Add automated smoke: `POST /internal/test/roundtrip` with representative payloads.
Maya: I'll prepare the eval harness and schedule synthetic runs during the internal shadow week.
Liam: I'll own flags + routing logic and the per-tenant shed implementation.
Ava: Great. Please add blockers to the rollout doc by EOD Friday. We'll lock config Monday and do a short dry-run before scheduling the first micro-cohort. :raised_hands:
